summary: All three files contain substantial formal mathematical content: definitions, theorems, lemmas, and proofs relevant to PEPS tensor network formalization. UnionInjectivity.lean proves the union lemma for the normal PEPS Fundamental Theorem using NormalEdgeBlockingData. UnionInjectivityGeneral.lean proves the general union-of-injective-regions lemma over a bare ThreeBlockGeometry with the full two-step inverse application. UnionInjectivityGeneralBlue.lean provides the blue-side fiber-collapse factorization via a geometry involution swapping blue/complement blocks. None are pure import aggregators; all contain executable formal mathematics with detailed source references to arXiv:1804.04964.
